claim: You can configure Shield Advanced to respond automatically to application layer (layer 7) attacks against protected resources by counting or blocking the web requests that are part of the attack; this adds to the protection of an AWS WAF web ACL with your own rate-based rule. This automatic mitigation is the legacy Layer 7 Auto Mitigation (L7AM): the Anti-DDoS Managed Rule Group supersedes it, existing Shield Advanced customers can continue to use it, and new Shield Advanced customers who require it contact AWS Support.

qualifiers.condition: AWS WAF web ACL associated with the resource; legacy feature for new Shield Advanced customers

evidence.quote: You can configure Shield Advanced to respond automatically to mitigate application layer (layer 7) attacks against your protected application layer resources, by counting or blocking web requests that are part of the attack. This option is an addition to the application layer protection that you add through Shield Advanced with an AWS WAF web ACL and your own rate-based rule.
It supersedes the Layer 7 Auto Mitigation (L7AM) feature.
If you're an existing Shield Advanced customer, you can continue to use the legacy solution with existing or new AWS accounts.
If you're a new Shield Advanced customer and require access to the legacy solution, contact AWS Support.
